en: Sepia-toned historical postcard showing two large villas in a rural setting with a forest behind them and a flat-topped table mountain in the background. The left house is labeled 'Villa Edit.' and the right house 'Villa Clara.' Two women in long dresses stand in a field at the right edge. At the bottom the caption identifies the location as 'Sommerfrische Gohrisch.' and credits the printer 'Brück & Sohn, Meissen 1907'. Another label above the mountain reads 'lilienstein.'
